Resolves #19801

A `sortable: false` header still sorted on click. `grid.header.Button#onClick` and `table.header.Button#onClick` cycled `isSorted` without reading `sortable`, so the click showed the arrow and the container sorted the Store by the column's `dataField`. Both handlers now cycle `isSorted` only while `sortable` is true. The button handler (`super.onClick`) still runs, so a non-sortable header keeps its click.

Evidence: L2 (a unit spec red on `dev`, a live drive of the covid table) → L2 required (AC-1–AC-3).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `HeaderButtonSortable.spec.mjs`, for the grid and the table header: a click on a `sortable: false` button leaves `isSorted` null, keeps `neo-sort-hidden` and runs the handler. Once `sortable` is true, the same button cycles to `ASC`. On `dev` both fail with `isSorted` `'ASC'`. |
| AC-2 | Live on `examples/table/covid` at `9fc3777f42`: a click on `#` changes nothing (glyph hidden, the rows keep the Active order), and Country then sorts (Afghanistan, Albania, Algeria). On `dev`, the `#` click lit its arrow, and no header sorted after it (#19800). |
| AC-3 | `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/grid test/playwright/unit/table`: 296 passed. The grid header e2e specs: 34 passed. |
